revision.comment: 各国の式内社表の掲載。ただし、式内比定社は現在名神大社のみの状態、国史見在社・式外社も未掲載の状態。
revision.text:
'''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社16座8社（いずれも名神大社）・小社3座3社の計19座10社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[宗像郡]]''' 4座（並大） |- |'''宗像神社 三座'''||ムナカタノ||並名神大||||[[宗像大社]]||[[福岡県]][[宗像市]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580201.html] |- |'''織幡神社'''||オリハタノ||名神大||||[[織幡神社]]||福岡県宗像市||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580301.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[那珂郡]]''' 4座（並大） |- |'''八幡大菩薩筥埼宮'''||-ハコサキノミヤ||名神大||||[[筥崎宮]]||福岡県[[福岡市]][[東区 (福岡市)|東区]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/586001.html] |- |'''住吉神社 三座'''||スミヨシノ||並名神大||||[[住吉神社 (福岡市)|住吉神社]]||福岡県福岡市[[博多区]]||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580601.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[糟屋郡]]''' 3座（並大） |- |'''志加海神社 三座'''||-ウミノ

'''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また[[式外社]]として、当時すでに当国に存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式神名帳』には、大社16座8社（いずれも名神大社）・小社3座3社の計19座10社が記載。 {{注|（凡例）
1）「神名帳」列は、[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年、近代デジタルライブラリー）等における『[[延喜式神名帳]]』の記載を基に作成。社名表記は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（5を参照）における字体（異体字がある場合には新字体・通用性の高い字体を使用）を基準とした。読みの「-」部分は、「神社」以外で仮名が振られていない部分。「○座」は座数を表し、一座の場合は記載していない。
2）格の「名神大」は[[名神大社]]を、「大」は式内大社（名神大社除く）を、「小」は式内小社を意味する。付記は社名とともに記されているもので、その主要なものについては「[[式内社#式内社の社格]]」を参照。
3）比定社が複数ある場合、最も有力なものを無冠で示し、他の論社には「（論）」を冠した。
4）本来の式内社とは認めがたいものの、式内社を合祀したなど、その後継を主張するもの、その他参考の神社には「（参）」を冠した。
5）「集成」列は[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjaindex.html 神社史料集成]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」）における神社項へのリンク先を記載。}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap" align="left" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | 神名帳 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 読み !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 格 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 付記 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[宗像郡]]''' 4座（並大） |- |'''宗像神社 三座'''||ムナカタノ||並名神大||||[[宗像大社]]||沖津宮：[[福岡県]][[宗像市]]大島[[沖ノ島]]
中津宮：福岡県宗像市大島
辺津宮：福岡県宗像市田島||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580201.html] |- |'''織幡神社'''||オリハタノ||名神大||||[[織幡神社]]||福岡県宗像市鐘崎||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580301.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[那珂郡 (筑前国)|那珂郡]]''' 4座（並大） |- |'''八幡大菩薩筥埼宮'''||-ハコサキノミヤ||名神大||||[[筥崎宮]]||福岡県[[福岡市]][[東区 (福岡市)|東区]]箱崎||（一宮）||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/586001.html] |- |'''住吉神社 三座'''||スミヨシノ||並名神大||||[[住吉神社 (福岡市)|住吉神社]]||福岡県福岡市[[博多区]]住吉||[[一宮]]||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580601.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[糟屋郡]]''' 3座（並大） |- |'''志加海神社 三座'''||-ウミノ

下宮：福岡県太宰府市内山||||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580101.html] |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[上座郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''麻弖良布神社'''||マテラフノ||小||||[[麻氐良布神社]]||福岡県[[朝倉市]]杷木志波|||| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[下座郡]]''' 3座（並大） |- |rowspan=2|'''美奈宜神社 三座'''||rowspan=2|ミナギノ||rowspan=2|並名神大||rowspan=2| ||（論）[[美奈宜神社 (朝倉市荷原)|美奈宜神社]]||福岡県[[朝倉市]]荷原||||rowspan=2|[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/580502.html] |- |（論）[[美奈宜神社 (朝倉市林田)|美奈宜神社]]||福岡県朝倉市林田|| |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''[[夜須郡]]''' 1座（小） |- |'''於保奈牟智神社'''||ヲホナムチノ
オホナモチ||小||||[[大己貴神社 (筑前町)|大己貴神社]]||福岡県[[朝倉郡]][[筑前町]]弥永|||| |} {{-}} == 式外社 == 当時すでに存在したはずであるのに『延喜式神名帳』に記載の無い神社。 === 国史見在社 === [[六国史]]に記載のある式外社。 {{節stub}} === その他 === 国史見在社以外の式外社。 {{節stub}} == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1442211 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー * [http://kindai.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1273537 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 近代デジタルライブラリー == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate58.html 筑前国 式内社19座]（國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」） {{式内社一覧}} {{DEFAULTSORT:ちくせんのくにのしきないしやいちらん}} [[Category:筑前国の式内社|*]] [[Category:式内社の一覧]]

'''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[延喜式]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 == 式内社 == 『延喜式』神名帳では、大社16座8社（いずれも名神大社）・小社3座3社の計19座10社を記載。 {{式内社一覧/凡例}} {{式内社一覧/header}} {{筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国那珂郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国糟屋郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国怡土郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国御笠郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国上座郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国下座郡の式内社一覧}} {{筑前国夜須郡の式内社一覧}} {{式内社一覧/footer}} == 式外社 == {{節stub}} 『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが、同帳に記載の無い神社。 == 廟 == 次の香椎宮は『延喜式』の段階で存在するが、神名帳には掲載されず、神名帳以外において「廟」として記される。平安時代中頃から神社化した。 {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; white-space:nowrap; font-size:85%" !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=2 | 文献 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | 比定社 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | 集成 |- !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 廟名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 記事 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 社名 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 所在地 !align="center" style="background:#a0f0a0" | 備考 |- |'''香椎廟'''

（樫日廟/橿日廟など）||『続日本紀』天平9年（737年）4月1日条ほか||[[香椎宮]]||福岡県福岡市東区香椎|| ||[http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/587001.html] |} == 参考文献 == * 皇典講究所・全国神職会校訂[{{NDLDC|1442211/160}} 『延喜式 上巻』]（大岡山書店、昭和4年） - 国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション * [{{NDLDC|1273537/37}} 『延喜式 第2』]（日本古典全集刊行会、昭和4年） - 国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション == 外部リンク == * [http://21coe.kokugakuin.ac.jp/db/jinja/jinjastate58.html 筑前国 式内社19座] - 國學院大學21世紀COEプログラム「神道・神社史料集成」 {{式内社一覧}} {{DEFAULTSORT:ちくせんのくにのしきないしやいちらん}} [[Category:Fixed imported list of Shikinaisha and templates]] [[Category:qq]][[sn:筑前国のList of Shikinai Shrines]][[Category:qq]] [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] [[Category:erroneous transclusions of 筑前国の式内社一覧]] [[Category:筑前国の式内社|*]] [[Category:Fixed imported list of Shikinaisha and templates]] [[Category:qq]][[sn:筑前国のList of Shikinai Shrines]][[Category:qq]] [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] [[Category:erroneous transclusions of 筑前国の式内社一覧]] [[Category:Lists of Shikinaisha by location]] [[Category:qq]][[sn:筑前国のList of Shikinai Shrines]][[Category:qq]] [[Category:qq]][[sn:筑前国の式内社一覧]][[Category:qq]]{{DEFAULTSORT:筑前国のList of Shikinai Shrines}}

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== == Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} == Shikinaisha removed from templates== ==Shikinaisha List Templates to be Depopulated== {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

Exception if there is another comment explaining the exception below{{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} '''筑前国の式内社一覧'''（ちくぜんのくにのしきないしゃいちらん）は、『[[Engishiki]]』第9巻・第10巻「神名帳上下」（[[延喜式神名帳]]）に記載のある[[神社]]、いわゆる「[[式内社]]」およびその[[論社]]のうち、[[筑前国]]に分類されている神社の一覧。 また『延喜式』神名帳の編纂当時に存在したが同帳に記載の無い神社、いわゆる「[[式外社]]」についても付記する。 ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:35, 31 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:49, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} – {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{ill|User:Immanuelle|de|User:Immanuelle|ja|User:Immanuelle|zh|User:Immanuelle}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 09:48, 26 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:01, 18 March 2025 (UTC)}} ({{ill|User talk:Immanuelle|de|User talk:Immanuelle|ja|User talk:Immanuelle|zh|User talk:Immanuelle}}) 05:34, 17 March 2025 (UTC)}} [[ja:筑前国の式内社一覧]] '''List of Shikinai Shrines in Chikuzen Province''' (筑前国の式内社一覧) is a list of {{ill|Shinto Shrine|de|Shinto Shrine|ja|神社|zh|神社}}, namely the {{ill|Shikinaisha|de|Shikinaisha|ja|式内社|1=Shikinaisha|zh|式内社}} and their associated {{ill|Ronsha|de|Ronsha|ja|論社|zh|論社}}, as recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} (volumes 9 and 10 “Kamyouchou Jouge” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳}}) and classified under {{ill|Chikuzen Province|de|Chikuzen Province|ja|筑前国|zh|筑前国}}. In addition, shrines that existed at the time of the compilation of the {{ill|Engishiki|de|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|zh|延喜式}} Jinmyōchō but are not recorded therein—the so-called {{ill|Shikigaisha|de|Shikigaisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|zh|式外社}}—are also noted. == Designated Shrines == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=4 | {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳}} ! style="background:#a0f0a0" colspan=3 | Designated Shrines ! style="background:#a0f0a0" rowspan=2 | Compilation |- style="white-space:nowrap;" ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Reading ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Rank ! style="background:#a0f0a0;" | Note ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.6em; padding-left:2.6em;" | Shrine Name ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.1em; padding-left:2.1em;" | Location ! style="background:#a0f0a0; padding-right:2.3em; padding-left:2.3em;" | Remarks |- |colspan=8 style="background-color:#ccffcc;"|'''{{ill|Munakata District|de|Munakata District|ja|宗像郡|zh|宗像郡}}''' 4 shrines (Standard Great) {{Tnavbar|List of Shikinai Shrines in Munakata District, Chikuzen Province|de|Liste der Shikinaisha im Bezirk Munakata, Provinz Chikuzen|ja|筑前国宗像郡の式内社一覧|zh|筑前国宗像郡的式内社列表|mini=1|style=float:right}} |- |'''Munakata Shrine (three sites)'''||munakatano||Standard Myōjin Taisha||||{{ill|Munakata Taisha|de|Munakata‑Taisha|ja|宗像大社|zh|宗像大社}}||Okitsu‑no‑miya : Fukuoka Prefecture, Munakata City, Ōshima (Okinoshima)

This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|12=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|12=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|12=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|12=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|12=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|12=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|12=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|12=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! revision.text:
This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}. We will cover them in a separate list to avoid confusion. == Shikinai Shrines (式内社) == In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|de|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|zh|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft}}, a total of 19 groups comprising 10 shrines (8 of the 16 large shrines, all {{ill|Myojin Taisha|de|Myojin Taisha|ja|明神大社|zh|明神大社|qq=draft}}, and 3 of the 3 small shrines) are recorded. {{List of Shikinaisha/Legend}} {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff; font-size:85%" ! This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. This is a '''List of Shikinaisha in Chikuzen Province'''. Or the list of shrines in [[Chikuzen Province]] which is present in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}. On this page we will also cover the {{ill|Shikigeisha|ja|式外社|1=Shikigeisha|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|13=User:Immanuelle/Shikigeisha|qq=}} of [[Chikuzen Province]] which are shrines that are known to have existed at that time due to other historical records, such as the [[Rikkokushi]], but for some reason were excluded from the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyocho|ja|延喜式神名帳|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō|qq=}}.
